ev.q: the objective is more often to see how far one can get before dying
Each level is a randomly generated maze of interconnected rooms
Artifacts are powerful weapons and armor that have a randomly generated name
The player begins the game with seven chosen skills, which may be further improved
The game is turn-based, and both the player and numerous enemies take turns performing actions
The combat focuses on melee, ranged, and magic attacks
its humor sets it apart from other roguelikes
Nathan Meunier of IGN called Dungeons of Dredmor challenging
